hypotheses.rationale: The Planner incorrectly interprets the question 'Which other Mexican Formula One race car driver...' as asking for 'shared podiums' (drivers on the same podium at the same race). The question actually asks for any *other* Mexican driver who has ever stood on a podium (Pérez did, but so did Rodríguez; the user asks for the *other* one besides Pérez). This fundamental misinterpretation of the task constraint leads to a fruitless search for overlapping events rather than simply listing all Mexican podium finishers.
hypotheses.check: Verify if the Planner understood the task as finding 'drivers on the same podium simultaneously' versus 'any other Mexican driver with a podium'. Compare this interpretation against the actual query: 'Which other... besides [Pérez]'.
